proof: Concurrent duplicate submission binds Idempotency-Key to the canonical scoped request digest and returns one durable inbox entry.
Concurrent processors use bounded PostgreSQL SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claims and create one DatasetVersion and one handoff per evidence record.
Changed payloads under a reused Idempotency-Key or evidence ID fail closed with HTTP 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
Cross-tenant and cross-user reads return scoped absence semantics, and failed extraction records remain available through the scoped DLQ and replay path.
The scoped evidence digest deterministically binds the inbox record, stable dataset_version_id, and one Observe/Learn-only handoff.
Acknowledgement requires the exact dataset_version_id and digest, persisting one acknowledgement_id without creating runtime, deployment, broker, or capital authority.

single_evidence_store_invariant.proof: No parallel evidence store or duplicate loop state store is created or modified. All evidence admission and handoffs go strictly through AgoraDatasetStore.

environment_boundary.proof: Verification executed within isolated virtualenv .venv-pantheon and test clients.

no_live_capital.proof: The implementation imports no runtime, capital, broker, order, promotion, or deployment writer and handoffs are explicitly Observe/Learn only.

rbac.proof: Viewer reads remain allowed while submit, process, DLQ replay, and acknowledgement mutations require write role authority.

tenant_isolation.proof: All inbox, dataset, DLQ, replay, lease, handoff, and acknowledgement keys and predicates enforce authenticated tenant_id and user_id.
